title: Re-investigation of functional gastrointestinal disorders utilizing a machine learning approach
summary: 3,765 patients with FGIDs first on GI symptoms and then combine symptoms with psychological factors, yielding eight additional well-separated mixed-factor clusters. This is an exploratory cross-sectional cohort result, not validated new diagnostic criteria.
